item.title: Black History in Southern Indiana
item.description: Southern Indiana has a deep history and connection when it comes to Black history. Southern Indiana was a glimmer of hope for African Americans during the Civil War because it is one of the first stops just beyond the Mason Dixon line, which was considered 'free land'. Learn about our communities ties to the Underground Railroad and other eye-opening stories.
